source_roles.ACCEPTANCE_EVENT: Accepted governing event whose effective normative propositions may create obligation units.
source_roles.GOVERNING_TRACE: Existing governing source used to test obligation granularity and realization tracing.
source_roles.SUPPLEMENTAL_KNOWN_WITNESS: Accepted source included for a preregistered known realization-gap witness.
source_roles.NEGATIVE_CONTROL: Research/candidate artifact that discusses requirements but is not itself an accepted governing transition.

unit_rule: An ObligationUnit is the smallest semantic group of accepted normative propositions sharing one realization boundary and one evidence path. Split independent realization paths even inside one paragraph; group propositions only when realization and evidence are genuinely shared.

realization_state_derivation.LINKED: realization relation exists, but evidence_refs empty
realization_state_derivation.OPERATIONAL: realization, evidence, qualification and activation refs all non-empty

grouping_metric.name: pairwise_same_unit_f1
grouping_metric.domain: all matched proposition pairs within the same source
grouping_metric.degenerate_rule: if neither reviewer groups any matched pair together, score 1.0
